name: Nervous Gardener
oracle_text:
Disguise {G} (You may cast this card face down for {3} as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time for its disguise cost.)
When this creature is turned face up, search your library for a land card with a basic land type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
blocked_sentences: Disguise {G} (You may cast this card face down for {3} as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time for its disguise cost.)

needs.what: the disguise alternative cast (702.168): cast face down for {3} as a 2/2 colourless nameless creature that has ward {2}, turnable face up for the printed disguise cost as a special action
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `morph` in card_level_cost_keys gives the face-down {3} 2/2 and the turn-face-up action, but its face-down characteristics carry no abilities, so a disguised permanent would lack ward {2}; nothing on the card can grant ward to its own face-down form, and the engine has no disguise handling at all. The turned-face-up trigger itself is expressible (`turned_face_up` event plus `search_library` with a basic-land-type selector), so only the disguise line blocks the card
